about: Fixed language-quality regression corpus built from REAL generation logs (v676-v682). Each entry is one real sentence, the target it was generated for, the verdict the app gave (observed), the verdict it should give (expected) and the linguistic reason. Both false acceptances and false rejections are recorded. reviewer = who judged the expected verdict: 'claude' = AI judgement (Claude), NOT native-speaker verified. 'native' entries would carry the reviewer's name; there are none yet. policy = the expected verdict depends on a curriculum decision (e.g. whether a particle counts as taught), not on correctness.

sources.zh-1012: mandarin-gen-log-2026-10-12.txt (owner upload, production v682, Mukyu, 90/90 READY)

entries.reason: 一緒 is a noun used as 一緒に (together) or 一緒だ (the same / together); it cannot be the subject of ある. Produced by the deterministic fallback, not the model.
'Will you understand tomorrow?' is not a natural question; a time word glued to 分かる by template. Fallback output.

entries.policy: かな is an everyday sentence-final particle; blocking it forced three fallbacks for どれ
entries.reason: Natural 'I wonder which is good'. Rejected only because かな is not in the grammar scaffold.

entries.text: あ、ごめん！ 分かんない。
entries.reason: あ is an interjection, not content vocabulary; 分かんない is the colloquial form of 分からない.

entries.text: あ、すみません、分からない。
entries.reason: Interjection あ treated as untaught content.

entries.policy: どうもありがとう is a fixed phrase built on taught ありがとう
entries.reason: Fixed expression; note it does NOT practise どう (different word) - so for target どう it should be rejected as target-absent, not as untaught.
The English was 'Won't you ride together? (invitation)' - a question followed by a note in brackets; the form check read the closing ')' instead of '?'.

entries.text: いい場所、どこか知ってる？
entries.observed: reject ('どこ' cannot be the argument of 知る)
entries.reason: The sentence uses どこか (somewhere), not どこ: 'Do you know somewhere good?' is natural. The rule matched どこ inside どこか.

entries.text: 駅で待ってるよ。早く来てね。
entries.observed: reject ('早い来る' needs a particle)
entries.reason: 早く is the adverb form of 早い; the analyser lemmatised it to 早い and treated it as a bare noun.

entries.text: どこか行きたい場所、ある？
entries.category: correct rejection (どこ vs どこか)
entries.reason: どこか (somewhere) does not practise どこ (where).

entries.observed: reject (same application as どの電車に乗る？)
entries.reason: Only the softening の differs.

entries.text: あ、ごめん。今日、忙しいんだ。
entries.observed: accept (as distinct from ごめん、今日、忙しいんだ。)
entries.reason: Only the interjection and the full stop differ (fixed in v682 commit 954c2ed; kept as a regression item).
時間 is genuinely untaught content.

entries.observed: accept (deterministic fallback; QC later flagged 2/5 and kept it)
entries.reason: Not Mandarin. 'There is not' is 没有; 不 cannot follow 有.

entries.observed: reject (segments do not reconstruct the sentence)
entries.reason: Correct 'I'm looking for you'; rejected by a segmentation consistency check, not by any language problem.

entries.observed: reject (segments do not reconstruct the sentence)
entries.reason: Correct 'I'll wait for you'.
Adjective + 一点 is comparative ('a bit smaller') and does not take 吗 like this; 'Is this a bit small?' is 这个有点小吗？
Fragment 'that one a bit smaller' - no verb or request (要小一点的).
人多 is a lexicalised state ('crowded'); topic + 人多 is natural, unlike a bare 这个大.
A bare adjective predicate implies a comparison; a standalone statement needs 很 / 太…了 / 不.

entries.policy: 什么时候 is one question word for 'when'; if 什么 is taught, teaching 什么时候 as a unit is a curriculum decision
entries.reason: 时候 is untaught.

entries.observed: reject ×9 (same application) - model resubmitted the same shape 9 times
entries.reason: Same frame as accepted 这个很大 with another adjective. The defect is the 9 paid retries, not the verdict.
回 needs 家 / 去 / 来.

entries.text: บ้านหลังนั้นสวยมากครับ
entries.reason: Here หลัง is the classifier for houses, not 'after / back' - the target's intended sense is never practised.

entries.text: บ้านหลังนั้นมีกี่หลังคะ
entries.reason: Circular and unnatural; also the classifier sense.

entries.text: ผมขอร้านกาแฟครับ
entries.reason: 'I request a coffee shop' - ขอ takes a thing you are given (ขอกาแฟ) or an action (ขอไป…); a shop is not requested.

entries.text: เราไปกันหนึ่งคนครับ
entries.reason: ไปกัน (go together) contradicts หนึ่งคน (one person); 'only I am going' is ผมไปคนเดียว.

entries.text: ผมไปกับเพื่อนหนึ่งคู่ครับ
entries.reason: Friends are not counted in คู่ in this way; 'with a couple' is ไปกับแฟน / กับเพื่อนสองคน.

entries.text: ผมจะไปรถตู้ครับ
entries.reason: Travel by vehicle needs นั่ง / ขึ้น (นั่งรถตู้ไป).

entries.text: เรานั่งรถตู้ไปกันไหมครับ
entries.reason: Correct vehicle collocation.

entries.text: สอบได้ศูนย์คะ
entries.reason: Male speaker with a female particle; also คะ on a statement should be ค่ะ.

entries.text: คุณจะไปเมื่อไหร่คะ
entries.observed: reject ×11 (speaker A male) in sandbox round 2
entries.reason: Correct female question; the generator assigned it to the male speaker (fixed in 2ee5bde / 45a693a; kept as a regression item).

entries.text: ทางไปไกลยาวนะครับ
entries.reason: ไกล (far) and ยาว (long) stacked without a link is unnatural; the next recall ทางไปไกล ยาวครับ was a near copy.
